claims.text: House adopted H.Con.Res. 194 disapproving the AWACS sale 301–111 on 14 Oct 1981; the Senate rejected it 48–52 on 28 Oct 1981, so the sale proceeded.
House passed H.Res. 771 standing with Israel 412–10 (25 Oct 2023).
Senate rejected Sanders's resolution on about $8.8bn of sales 82–15 on 3 Apr 2025; 19 Democrats backed similar resolutions in Nov 2024; Jan 2024 Sanders measure failed 72–11; Schumer voted no.
30 Jul 2025: S.J.Res. 34 ($676m sale of 5,000 bombs and guidance kits) failed 27–70; 12 new supporters since April incl. King, Shaheen, Reed, Murray; Risch called resolutions 'misguided'.
House passed Antisemitism Awareness Act (H.R. 6090) 320–91 on 1 May 2024; would apply IHRA definition in Title VI enforcement; ACLU calls definition 'overbroad'.

Senate HELP markup of S.558 (29–30 Apr 2025): amendments incl. Sanders's on criticizing Israeli government; Cassidy: 'Supporting these amendments is an effort to kill this bill'; no vote; bill stalled in committee.
House passed the US-Israel Enhanced Security Cooperation Act 411–2 on 9 May 2012 (Paul and Dingell no).
House passed the US-Israel Strategic Partnership Act 410–1 in March 2014.
30 Jul 2025: 27 senators backed blocking 20,000 rifles for Israel's police; 24 backed blocking $675m in bombs; all Republicans opposed.
15 Apr 2026: Senate rejected blocking $295m bulldozer sale 59–40 and $151.8m sale of 12,000 1,000-lb bombs 63–36; supporters all Democratic caucus.

ow2_fara.topic: FARA, the lobby and the money question

claims.text: FARA defines an agent as one acting 'at the order, request, or under the direction or control' of a foreign principal; an agent properly registered under the LDA is exempt, but the exemption does not apply where a foreign government or party is the principal beneficiary.

DOJ OIG (Sep 2016): 62% of new registrants filed late; 50% of supplemental statements late; need for 'a comprehensive Department enforcement strategy on FARA'; compliance rates 'unacceptable'; no injunctive remedy used since 1991.

Fulbright's Senate Foreign Relations inquiry into the Jewish Agency's funding began 2 Aug 1963 (Barda); Hamlin testimony; $38,000 for Near East Report subscriptions; Kenen affidavit (purchases never above 23%); Barda gives $1.5m 1955–62 and calls separation 'absolute' (his interpretation).

Forward opinion analysis (Bahar) of 788 AIPAC PAC-backed candidates 2022–24: ~86% incumbents; non-incumbents won ~91% of primaries; ~79% in tight races vs NRA 84%, Planned Parenthood 83%, Sierra Club 88%; argues AIPAC not more effective than other lobbies.
